title: Choosing a phone for Grandpa
instructions: Bir kadın dedesi için telefon seçiyor. İhtiyaçları ve son kararı takip et.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Hi. I'm looking for a phone for my grandfather. He's eighty-five.

script.speaker: a
script.text: What does he need it for?

script.speaker: b
script.text: Just calls and messages. He doesn't want the internet. And his eyes aren't very good.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Then this one is perfect. It has big buttons and a big screen.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Sixty pounds. The battery lasts about a week.

script.speaker: b
script.text: That's good. He always forgets to charge his phone. I'll take it.

questions.prompt: What does he need the phone for?
Why is the phone perfect for him?
options: It has big buttons and a big screen.
questions.feedback: Büyük tuşları ve büyük ekranı var.
questions.evidence: It has big buttons and a big screen.

questions.prompt: Why is the long battery good?
options: He uses the phone a lot.
He always forgets to charge his phone.
questions.evidence: He always forgets to charge his phone.
